approval.standard: eastward-edges.md 5.1 and 5.5, art-style.md density 3; the Frostline brief (snow lying on what faces the sky, granite and slate, lake ice)
approval.note: The tarn's outlet open and thawing (Matt, 23 Nov), painted from the zone's plan over its water cells: calm winter water (water_winter) with a darker thalweg, a dark band stepping back under the north banks, the snow's broken reflection under the south banks, paired lit streaks along the flow lanes; soft-grid banks that wander off the cells on every reach, a face only on north banks and a rim on every other shore; the tarn's one lead fanning into a ragged mouth; the pool climbing in value into the fall's tongue; shelf ice and floes near the tarn; the ice-cutter's hole in the same water; the climb to the brook's own colours in tongues along the flow below the bridge. Its foot is the top of its box (it lies under every other ground piece); regenerate after changing the zone's water cells.

audit.size_class: unsized (the outlet's water surface: ground dressing over the zone's water cells)
